title: 情感圈最大造假丑闻 Jackson造假实锤 团队解散跑路

timeline.summary: A montage repeats a man's apparent admission that people under him fabricated material, intercut with another man defending risk-taking and 'showing the most authentic dynamics'.
The edit uses creator clips, a dated group-chat screenshot, staged-versus-real labels, street footage and repeated '确实造假了' overlays to frame a team dispute.
Several speakers/clips say whoever fabricated should leave, refer to paying 150 units for an actor, and show a man saying he allowed Hank and others to fabricate.
A long-haired commentator says criticism may affect others' interests but invites challengers to record material for him to review.
The montage adds claims about large sums and that 'Mikey' should learn a 'real' approach; the long-haired speaker says time will correct everything, identifies himself as Jason and signs off.

claims.speaker: multiple third-party speakers in edited montage
claims.statement: The montage presents selected statements as admissions that team members staged or fabricated content, including paid actors and permission from leadership.
claims.conditions: Speaker identities, dates, source completeness and the meaning of each quoted statement are not independently verified.

claims.speaker: Jason, as self-identified at the outro
claims.statement: He presents his own material as more authentic, invites challenges and says time will correct matters.
claims.conditions: Competitive self-positioning in an adversarial edit; it does not verify his allegations or outcomes.

visual_findings: All sampled and one-second frames show a rapid multi-source montage: live clips, chat screenshot, creator monologues, street/date snippets, meme overlays and a Jason outro.
The edit repeatedly overlays '确实造假了' and labels clips '真实'; these are editorial assertions and do not authenticate the footage.
Mikey is discussed by name and image in some inserts, but no clearly isolated new Mikey-authored proposition is established in this standalone copy.

permissions.reason: The underlying third-party video is already contained in formal live-038, and all serious named-person claims remain unverified.

limitations: Automatic ASR collapses many rapid speaker switches and misrecognizes names and amounts.
No original source chain, unedited recordings, accused-party record, contracts or payment evidence was authenticated.
The short cannot establish fraud, team dissolution, flight, legal liability or causal harm despite its title.
